text: An LLM works in four steps.

The first two happen before you use it: pre-training, where the model reads vast text collections to learn general language patterns and facts; and fine-tuning with human feedback, which trains it to be a helpful, polite assistant that follows instructions.
When you send a message, step three turns your text into tokens.
Step four predicts the reply piece by piece, token by token.

Always keep three essentials in mind: the model has a fixed knowledge cutoff date, it does not look things up by default, and it can invent false details with complete confidence—known as a hallucination.
